did.unittitle: Lincoln Chen papers

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: This collection documents various conferences, meetings, and workshops attended by Lincoln Chen, both during his tenure at the Rockefeller Foundation and at the Global Equity Initiative. The files include agendas, participant lists, articles and pre-readings, promotional information, and notes.

accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access
accessrestrict.p: Open for research with select materials restricted as noted. Brittle or damaged items are available at the discretion of RAC. Researchers interested in accessing digital media (floppy disks, CDs, DVDs, etc.) in this collection must use an access surrogate. The original items may not be accessed because of preservation concerns. To request an access surrogate be made, or if you are unsure if there is an access surrogate, please contact an archivist.

bioghist.head: Biographical / Historical
bioghist.p: Lincoln Chen is an expert on international public health. He graduated from Princeton University (BA), Harvard Medical School (MD), and the Johns Hopkins School of Hygiene and Public Health (MPH). In 1973, Dr. Chen joined the Ford Foundation, serving in Bangladesh and India. From 1987 to 1996, he served as Taro Takemi Professor of International Health at the Harvard School of Public Health as well as Director of the University-wide Harvard Center for Population and Development Studies. He then joined the Rockefeller Foundation as Executive Vice President for Strategy. In 2001, he founded the Global Equity Initiative at the John F. Kennedy School of Government at Harvard University. He was Director of the Initiative from 2001 to 2006. Dr. Chen is currently the President of the China Medical Board.

acqinfo.head: Immediate Source of Acquisition
acqinfo.p: The collection was received from Lincoln Chen in two shipments in 2009.
